statement:
by
  classical
  exact let R := fun n : ℕ => ((Finset.Icc 1 (Nat.log 2 n)).filter (fun e => Nat.Prime (n-2^e))).card; ∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ ∃ T : ℕ, ∀ X H : ℕ, T ≤ X → X ≤ H^2 → H ≤ X → c*(H:ℝ) ≤ (((Finset.Ico X (X+H)).filter (fun n => Odd n ∧ R n=1)).card:ℝ)

plain_statement.zh: 在每个平方根长度以上的窗口，唯一表示为素数加一个正指数二幂的奇数都有正比例。
plain_statement.en: Positive density of uniquely represented odd integers in every square-root-length window.

brief.zh: Elsholtz–Schlage-Puchta 的唯一表示结果给出全局正下密度。局部结论可检测反射侧的质量是否集中在高重数点。需要在同一动窗内隔离恰一次的贡献，并把其他所有允许指数也纳入排除。
brief.en: Elsholtz and Schlage-Puchta prove positive lower density of unique representations globally. Isolate multiplicity exactly one in each moving window and exclude all other exponents. This distinguishes support size from a first-moment bound.
